messages.subject: Problem using script exact_matches
parts:
Hello,
 
When I try to use the script exact_matches as described on p141 of the book, I get an error message:
 

> corpus.file<-scan(choose.files(),what="char",sep="\n",quiet=T)
> sentences<-grep("<s n=",corpus.file,perl=T,value=T)
> source("C:\\_qclwr\\_scripts\\exact_matches.r")
> out<-exact.matches("<w AJ0(-AV0)?>right\\b", sentences, pcre=T, case.sens=F)
Error in starts + unlist(sapply(matches, attributes)) :
  non-numeric argument to binary operator

 

I have no idea what the cause of this problem is. I hope someone can help me with this!
 
Thanks in advance,
 
Tim
